summary: Stage 1 MCP HTTP host/port validation and pinned loopback binding remain compliant. The original F-001 DNS-rebinding Host/Origin finding was confirmed pre-fix and resolved by restricting the request allowlist to the verified numeric bind address and reserved localhost.
summary_markdown: See T15-review.md for the preserved pre-fix finding and T15-recheck.md for current-path evidence, regression results, and scoped limitations.

acceptance.criterion: Only verified unambiguous loopback binds; wildcard/nonloopback and resolution errors fail before SDK connection/bind.
acceptance.evidence: loopback-host.ts validates numeric literals, resolves hostnames with bounded all-address lookup, rejects non-loopback/ambiguous/error results; local tests cover invalid hosts and ports before connect.

acceptance.criterion: Host/Origin cannot bypass local HTTP boundary; failures do not leak unsafe input or report startup success.
acceptance.evidence: Foreign Host/Origin, cross-site headers, and configured-name same-origin headers are refused; the guard receives only the verified numeric bind address and reserved localhost, and errors remain generic.

artifacts.summary: T15 staged MCP HTTP security review

findings.problem: The MCP HTTP request guard allows the original arbitrary configured DNS hostname in Host and matching Origin headers after binding to a single verified loopback address.
findings.impact: An attacker controlling that hostname's DNS/origin can issue same-origin browser requests to the unauthenticated local MCP transport after DNS rebinding, bypassing the intended browser-origin boundary.
findings.suggested_fix: Allow only the pinned numeric bind address and reserved localhost, or revalidate the configured hostname against the pinned address on each request before dispatch.
findings.evidence: src/mcp/transport/http-sse.ts:32-37 and :65; direct deterministic call with an arbitrary configured host and matching Host/Origin returned accepted=true; transport.handleRequest then executes and http-sse.ts:6 documents no authentication.

class_scope.enumeration_method: Read all target transport code and trace the only request guard call from startHttpTransport to isTrustedMcpHttpRequest; direct pure-function reproduction confirmed acceptance.

disposition.evidence: Root change removed the configured DNS name from the runtime allowlist and made the guard reject nonnumeric/non-localhost entries; T15-recheck.md records the post-fix reproduction and focused test evidence.

verification.evidence: The pre-fix deterministic reproduction accepted the configured-name Host/Origin pair. The post-fix reproduction rejects it and accepts the pinned numeric and reserved-localhost cases; focused HTTP, boundary, and installer tests pass 26/0.
